units.source_text: 他用两只手指蘸了点唾沫，将信封封上，在封口上签了自己的名字。

en.t: He moistened two fingers with a little saliva, sealed the envelope, and signed his name across the flap.

units.source_text: 七段也在下方封口上签了名。

en.t: The seventh-dan player also signed across the lower seal.

units.source_text: 然后将这个信封套在另一个大信封里，工作人员在加封处签了名。

en.t: Then this envelope was placed inside another large envelope, and a staff member signed at the sealed spot.

units.source_text: 随后存放在红叶馆的保险柜里。

en.t: After that, it was stored in the safe at the Momiji-kan.
